Edit a biology parameter for a species by name

edit_param_sp.Rd

Dispatcher that routes to the appropriate parameter-editing function based on the value of param. Accepted parameter names (case-insensitive): "mum", "bhbeta", "bhaphla", "mq".

Usage

edit_param_sp(bio.lines, param, factor, species)

Arguments

bio.lines

Character vector of lines from the biology .prm file, typically the result of readLines().

param

Character string naming the parameter to edit. Must be one of "mum", "bhbeta", "bhaphla", or "mq" (case-insensitive).

factor

Numeric multiplier applied to the current parameter value.

species

Character string with the species code used in the Atlantis configuration (e.g. "CHY").

Value

The modified bio.lines vector.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  bio.lines <- readLines("AMPSbioparam.prm")
  bio.lines <- edit_param_sp(bio.lines, param = "mum", factor = 1.1, species = "CHY")
  writeLines(bio.lines, "AMPSbioparam.prm")
} # }
